info.title: Socal Mediation Center API
info.description: REST APIs for Socal mediation and legal consultation booking flows.

post.summary: Create or save a draft consultation
post.description: Creates the draft after consultation type selection. Optional fields can be sent from the details form to preserve partially completed data while the status remains draft.

description.example: Briefly describe the legal guidance or assistance needed.

referral_source_others.description: Used only when referral_source is Other Referral.

post.summary: Complete consultation details, schedule the slot, and send payment links
post.description: Send only schedule and payment fields when client details were already saved on the draft. Any client/detail fields included here override the draft values before payment links are created.

description.example: Need help reviewing a dispute before mediation.

referral_source_others.description: Used only when referral_source is Other Referral.

payment_participant_emails.description: For split payments, omit this field to split across all participants, or pass selected participant emails.

200.description: Consultation completed and payment links created

message.example: Consultation completed and payment links sent.

422.description: Validation failed, invalid service name, unavailable slot, or invalid payment split

post.description: Updates the selected date/time after checking availability. Online bookings get a regenerated Zoom meeting link, and Outlook sync recreates the calendar event so the old event is removed.

422.description: Unavailable slot, inactive booking, or validation failed

get.summary: Check whether a consultation can continue through reschedule flow
get.description: Returns only pending or completed. Completed consultations should not be rescheduled.

post.summary: Schedule an invited free intro participant slot
post.description: Used by additional Free 15-Min Intro Call participants who receive a secure scheduling email. The primary participant slot is reserved when the consultation is completed.

422.description: Invalid token, unavailable slot, or unsupported consultation type

get.summary: Return duration-based available slots for a consultation type and month
get.description: The day window comes from BOOKING_DAY_START and BOOKING_DAY_END in BOOKING_TIMEZONE. Slot spacing comes from the selected consultation type duration, and each slot is marked unavailable when it overlaps any application booking or locally synced Outlook busy event. Outlook is refreshed by the scheduled/admin sync, not inline during this read API.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Legacy fallback. Prefer date for selected-day availability.

post.summary: Verify a Converge payment after receiving return data
post.description: Accepts the payment reference from a Hosted Payment Page return, then queries Converge server-to-server before changing payment status. Supplied status fields are logged but never trusted as proof of payment.

422.description: Payment reference is missing or confirmation is invalid

post.summary: Mark one payment share paid in a non-production environment
post.description: Available only when payment simulation is enabled, Converge is disabled, and the application is not running in production. Paying the final share triggers the normal Zoom and Outlook finalization flow.

404.description: Simulation unavailable or payment request not found

409.description: Converge enabled or consultation cannot receive payment

post.summary: Receive the Hosted Payment Page browser return
post.description: Configure this URL in the Converge Hosted Payment Page profile. The callback is stored and processed immediately, then the browser is redirected without waiting for XML transaction verification.
